title: A Clinical Study of Optimized CT-guided Pulmonary Nodule Microcoil Localization Technique
brief_summary: In the early stage of the study, the CT-guided micro-coil locating method for pulmonary small nodules was optimized. This study will use a single set of target values non-randomized controlled trials to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of the optimized pre-loaded micro-coil locating method in pulmonary small nodules.
